Introduction to Role & Team

Badoo is one of the world's largest dating apps, connecting millions of people across the globe. It's a mature, much-loved product with enormous reach, and we're in the middle of an ambitious chapter: modernising the experience, sharpening how we help members find real connections, and building a healthier, more sustainable business.

As a Senior Product Designer on Badoo, you'll help shape that next chapter. You'll take end-to-end ownership of meaningful surfaces - onboarding, people discovery, chatting,, and the monetisation experiences that sit alongside them - designing for a global, diverse, and value-conscious membership. This is high-craft product design under real-world constraints: a lean, fast-moving team, an experiment-led culture, and a design foundation we're actively rebuilding.

You'll be a key voice at the intersection of product, engineering, research, and data - balancing sharp product thinking and strong craft with commercial pragmatism and a deep respect for the people who use Badoo. If you're energised by scale, comfortable making trade-offs explicit, and want your work to move both member and business outcomes, this is a rare canvas to work on.

What You’ll Do

  • Own end-to-end design for multiple Badoo surfaces leading the work from discovery and problem framing through interaction design, visual polish, and delivery.

  • Design experiences that balance member value with commercial impact: paywalls, consumables and subscription flows that feel fair and clear. Monetisation is central to Badoo's roadmap, and great design is what makes it work for members and the business.

  • Work in an experiment-led way. Most meaningful changes ship as A/B tests with clear hypotheses and guardrails, so you'll design for iteration and learning, not just a single polished hand-off, and stay close to the results.

  • Help modernise Badoo's design foundations. Our design system is a work in progress; you'll contribute patterns and components that raise consistency and quality across a large, mature product.

  • Collaborate closely with PMs, UXR, data science, and engineers to frame problems, validate hypotheses, synthesise insights, and evolve designs based on evidence, accepting that data is sometimes imperfect and that judgment matters.

  • Ship pragmatically within a lean team. Prioritise for member and business outcomes over perfection, make trade-offs explicit, and know when to push for the ideal experience and when to ship a well-reasoned version.

  • Design for a global, inclusive audience - a diverse international membership across many markets, languages, and devices - and for platform and compliance requirements as they evolve.

  • Apply AI-powered tools and methods to accelerate exploration, improve accessibility, and personalise experiences responsibly.

  • Give and receive design critique with precision and care while elevating the work around you and modelling a culture of high craft standards.

  • Model Bumble’s core competencies: collaborate with purpose, take ownership, adapt with agility, and deliver from insight to impact.

  • Embody our values of Courage, Respect, and Joy in how you work and the experiences you create.

About You

  • You’re an experienced end-to-end product designer with a track record of delivering thoughtful, high-quality mobile experiences from ambiguity to release.

  • You have a strong product mind: you frame problems before jumping to solutions, connect design decisions to user and business outcomes, and think in systems as much as screens.

  • You're commercially fluent and comfortable designing monetisation experiences that feel fair, and are a well-crafted part of the product rather than a bolt-on.

  • You thrive with constraints. You're pragmatic about scope, comfortable in a lean and fast-moving team, and energised by working on a mature product that needs modernising.

  • You're at home in an experiment-driven environment: designing for A/B tests, iterating on results, and reasoning under uncertainty in a two-sided marketplace where impact is hard to predict.

  • Your visual and interaction design craft is strong, your work is polished, considered, and reflects a deep understanding of what makes digital experiences feel right.

  • You bring real intentionality to your process: from how you frame a problem to how you design a transition, your work shows rigour, purpose, and care.

  • You balance user empathy with commercial pragmatism and know when to push for the ideal experience and when to ship a well-reasoned version.

  • You’re fluent in Figma and modern prototyping tools and you use them to think as well as to communicate.

  • You’re grounded in inclusive design principles and accessibility standards, and you bring a global mindset to your work.

  • You’re curious about AI’s role in product experiences and you apply these tools with ethical care and creative intention.

  • You take full ownership of your work: you drive things to a conclusion, communicate proactively, and build trust with partners across disciplines.

  • Typically requires 5-8 years of experience, though we welcome candidates with alternative backgrounds that demonstrate equivalent skills.

 

✨ Kind, curious, and low-ego designers thrive at Bumble Inc. If you’re excited to shape how people around the world form relationships and find belonging, we’d love to hear from you.

  • Annual personal learning & development budget

  • Private Medical Insurance (PMI)

  • Private Dental Insurance

  • Babylon Health app

  • Mental health support

  • Enhanced parental leave, including a highly competitive maternity package

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Subsidised gym membership

  • ‘Double matched’ pension contributions up to 6%

About Us

Bumble Inc. is the parent company of Bumble Date, BFF, and Badoo. The Bumble platform enables people to build healthy and equitable relationships, through Kind Connections. Founded by Whitney Wolfe Herd in 2014, Bumble was one of the first dating apps built with women at the center and connects people across dating (Bumble Date) and friendship (BFF). BFF is a friendship app where people in all stages of life can meet people nearby and create meaningful platonic connections and community based on shared interests. Badoo, which was founded in 2006, is one of the pioneers of web and mobile dating products.

AI Fluency

AI is important to us. We’re excited by people who are curious and experimental, and who think thoughtfully about how AI can amplify their impact and outcomes.

We encourage you to use AI responsibly as you prepare your application. Please don’t use it to fabricate experiences or answer questions live in interviews. You as part of tonies:

We're looking for an experienced Graphic/Visual Designer to own the design output of the tonies Accessories portfolio. Reporting to the Director of Accessories, you'll be responsible for CMF direction across all categories, 2D asset creation, product renders, licensor approval submissions, and Style Guide stewardship. You'll work within a structured product development process (PDP), holding the Responsible role across various design tasks — from initial ideation through to golden sample approval.

This is a role for someone who thinks in finished products that excite our target audiences, not just finished files. You understand that what you're designing will be held by a child, sitting on a shelf in a retailer in Germany, the US, or the UK, next to one of the most loved children's brands in the world. That context matters to you.


This role may NOT be a great fit if:
  • Your background is primarily in UI/UX, Web, or Digital Product Design.
  • Your experience is strictly in Hardlines or Industrial Hardware Design (e.g., plastic toys, consumer electronics, or pure hardware).   
  • You have no experience designing physical products aimed at kids, families, or youth lifestyle audiences.   
  • Your focus has been on managing external creative agencies or vendor design teams, rather than personally creating hands-on 2D production-ready artwork.


Your tasks and responsibilities will include:

Design ownership across the full PDP

  • Direct CMF (Color, Material, Finish) for all accessories categories — Headphones, Nightlights, Bags, Shelves, Decoration, and more.
  • Build design briefs for ODM/OEM manufacturing partners and own the construction sample process
  • Lead first sample and golden sample approvals against brand and CMF standards
  • Manage Top of Production (TOP) sample reviews and sign-off
  • Commission 3D packaging renders from supply partners and review against brand
Licensor management

  • Maintain the licensor submission tracker and ensure approvals stay on schedule
  • Build fluency with individual licensor style guides and maintain their application across the range
Brand stewardship

Cross-functional collaboration

  • Familiarity with a structured product development process (stage-gate, RACI-based, or similar)

  • Strong understanding of material and print processes — what a spec sheet needs to say, and why
  • English at a professional level; German is a strong plus
Nice to have:
  • 3D rendering capability (Keyshot, Rhino, or similar)
  • Experience designing within licensed brand style guides (entertainment IP, or similar)
  • Background in apparel, fashion & home accessories, or soft goods design (toys & consumer electronics is a plus)
  • Understanding of sustainable packaging and materials principles
  • Portfolio that demonstrates physical product development, not just graphic design

source_record.description:
Vision RT is a fast-growing MedTech company transforming radiation therapy for cancer patients by helping make it more accurate, effective, and comfortable. The company is the inventor of, and a market leader in, Surface Guided Radiation Therapy (SGRT). This technology uses advanced 3D cameras to track surface data, providing enhanced guidance across every step of the radiotherapy workflow.
 
Our systems are used in over 3,000 clinics worldwide, including in 29 of the top 30 Best Hospitals for Cancer (source: US News and World Report 2026 rankings).
 
The company is recognized as one of Britain’s fastest-growing private tech companies, as featured in the 2025 Sunday Times 100 Tech list. Vision RT is also a recipient of the 2026 King’s Award for Enterprise, our fifth in 10 years. It is the UK’s most prestigious accolade for business excellence.
 
Company video
 
With around 400+ employees globally and offices in the UK, Poland, and the USA, Vision RT operates independently as part of the Danish company William Demant Invest A/S, one of the world’s largest investors in healthcare companies. Employees benefit from the security and reach of being part of a large global enterprise, combined with the agility and innovation of a startup.
 
Vision RT is a company with strong values, a clear mission, and a bright future. It is an exciting and rewarding organization in which to work.
 

About the role

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Senior Management Accountant to join our finance team. This role plays a critical part in delivering accurate financial insights, supporting strategic decision-making, and driving business performance.

As a Senior Management Accountant, you will be responsible for preparing monthly management accounts, performing financial analysis, and partnering with key stakeholders across the business. You will ensure the integrity of financial reporting while identifying opportunities to improve processes, efficiency, and profitability.

Working closely with senior leadership, you will provide meaningful commentary on financial performance, budgets, and forecasts, helping to guide business strategy. This role also involves mentoring junior team members and contributing to the continuous development of the finance function. 

This is an excellent opportunity for a qualified accountant looking to take on a high-impact role within a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

Key responsibilities will include

• Preparing the monthly Management Accounts for subsidiaries. We currently have subsidiaries based in the UK, USA, Germany, China, Australia, Poland, India, Spain, Korea, Canada and Japan.
• Carrying out month-end tasks such as revenue recognition, cost of sales workings, accruals, prepayments, and maintenance of the fixed asset register.
• Balance Sheet reconciliations
• Bank reconciliations
• Debtor, creditor, and bank revaluations.
• Intercompany reconciliations
• Analyse the financial results to produce commentary for senior management for both internal and external reporting
• Carrying out project work such as improving files, systems, and processes.
• Responsible for VAT/GST Returns including any other Monthly/Quarterly local tax returns and ensure deadlines are always met
• Work with the local accountants/advisors to ensure the subsidiaries’ account balances are aligned with ours
• Responsible for any other applicable returns in the Subsidiaries as and when required
• Assist with the preparation and filing of the Statutory Accounts in the Subsidiary countries in line with IFRS/local GAAP requirements
• Assist with Year-End duties and annual audit
• Other ad hoc duties as and when required by the Financial Controller and Finance Director.

Essential Skills & Experience

• 5+ years of experience in an accounting environment, with knowledge of IFRS and UK GAAP
• Qualified Accountant
• International Experience
• Good Academics
• Month End Experience including Prepayments, Accruals, Revenue Recognition
• Strong analytical skills, with high attention to detail
• Good Excel skills including Vlookups, Pivot tables and Sumifs
• Able to work to strict deadlines
• Able to work independently and take the initiative in solving problems
• Solid understanding of basic accounting payable principles, including a good knowledge of VAT
• Proven ability to calculate, post and manage accounting figures and financial records
• Ability to communicate and work at all levels with a large number of stakeholders i.e. junior staff to senior management.

Desirable Skills & Experience

• Experience in leading teams and managing junior staff
• Experience using Sage 200, Credit Hound and TM1 – Apliqo
• Experience using Paperless
• Experience using WebExpenses
• Audit experience from a Big 4 or mid-tier firm

Vision RT is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and development without regard to race, colour, religion, sexual orientation, gender, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

Orbital is the AI platform for real estate legal work.

Real estate shapes the world around us: our homes, our workplaces and our cultural landmarks. It’s the infrastructure that powers everyday life and is the world's largest asset class. Yet behind every single deal, real estate and legal teams work hard to navigate decades-old complexity; manually connecting documents, hidden obligations, geo-spatial context, and multiple parties into a path forward. We connect the legal and physical record, so that path is clearer than ever before. Our mission is to make real estate transactions faster, clearer, and less manual.

Here, you'll be part of changing how the deals behind the largest asset class get transacted, and will help shape the future of real estate.

A bit about us:

🚀 We’re building at the forefront of AI technology, without losing the deeply human expertise our clients depend on.

🏢 Orbital is built with former practising real estate lawyers and 250+ years of combined legal expertise. We're purpose-built for the complexity of real estate: accelerating due diligence, drafting and negotiation, and deal coordination with legal-grade precision.

💰 We've just raised a $60m Series B, led by Brighton Park Capital, to accelerate our global expansion – $75m raised to date.

🤝 We're trusted by 5,000+ real estate professionals, spanning UK Magic Circle and US Am Law 100 firms, to household names like M&S. Leading firms like BCLP, Orrick, Goodwin, Womble Bond Dickinson and Clifford Chance rely on Orbital to remove the busywork, freeing legal and real estate teams to focus on sharp judgment, standout client service, and closing deals faster.

💡 Working at Orbital means joining a bold, ambitious team, with the trust to take ownership and make a real impact from day one.

Orbital's next phase of growth is US-led. New York is where the go-to-market weight is moving, and hiring follows it. We are hiring a Head of Talent to own that and all hiring across the UK and US.

This is a precision function, not a volume one. Every hire is expected to raise the bar. You will be measured on the calibre of who joins, not how many.

Talent at Orbital has been built and run by a specialist embedded partner, and that engagement now hands over to a permanent in-house function. The building blocks are in place and TA is a respected function in the business: Ashby, scorecards, interview design and reporting are all live and operating. Your job is to take that function fully in-house, own it permanently, and take it from good to exceptional.

What you'll own

The strategy. The company-wide hiring plan, built with the CEO, COO and CRO from growth targets. It is your role to define how that plan gets delivered, and you will have full autonomy to do it. From team to tools to operations.

The team. A precision talent team across the US and UK. The current TA team are all experienced recruiters. Your role is to coach and develop them into a genuinely high-impact team, and to hold that standard as it grows.

The method. Orbital hires direct. Your team works search-led: they map a market, build a target list and go after named people rather than working inbound. You set that standard, and you personally run the searches where seniority or business impact demands it.

What we're looking for

A scale-up track record. You have built or materially scaled a talent function inside a VC-backed technology company through a comparable arc, roughly 100 to 300 people.

Precision over volume. Your track record is low-volume, high-calibre hiring. You can point to specific hires that changed a company's trajectory and explain exactly how you found, engaged and closed them.

GTM and Engineering depth. You have personally owned both GTM and Engineering hiring in your career and have knowledge of the UK and US markets.

Executive search craft. You have designed and run targeted headhunt processes end to end for people who were not looking: market mapping, target lists, multi-touch engagement, assessment and close. You can walk us through the process, not just the outcome.

Executive-team fluency. You hold your own on commercial strategy with a CRO, technical org design with a CTO, planning with a COO, and the talent narrative with a CEO. You operate as a peer who brings a position, not a service provider taking a brief.

Operational rigour. Forecasts hold. Pipeline reviews happen. Data in the ATS is accurate without being chased. Follow-up does not slip, and stakeholders always know where a search stands. You are detail-oriented by instinct, because precision is what wins at this level.

US and UK experience. You have run a distributed recruiting team across US and UK time zones with a single operating rhythm, one quality bar and clear accountability in both markets.

A record of raising a team's level. Not just managing one. Clear expectations, honest feedback, visible performance data, real coaching on craft.

AI literacy in practice. You already build AI into how your function works, and you can show what it changed about your team's output.

This role is probably not for you if

  • You measure yourself on requisitions filled, time-to-fill and headcount delivered above all else.

  • You want to manage an agency panel and a vendor budget. We hire direct, and your job is to make agencies unnecessary.

  • You want to step back from the work. You will personally run the hardest searches.

  • You are not comfortable being uncomfortable and dealing with change.

  • Performance conversations are something you avoid or defer.

  • AI is something you talk about rather than something already in your workflow.

If that sounds like your job, apply

🔒 Security is everyone’s responsibility at Orbital. We ask all team members to follow our security policies, complete regular awareness training, and handle sensitive data with care in line with ISO 27001 standards. Spot something unusual? Reporting risks or incidents quickly helps us maintain the strong culture of security and compliance we all depend on.

💡 At Orbital, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We especially welcome applications from people who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. Even if you don’t meet every single requirement, or if the right role isn’t listed yet, we’d still love to hear from you.

Everyone who works with Orbital goes through background screening before they start. It's part of how we keep Orbital secure, for the people who work here and for the client information we're trusted with.

About CyberCube:

CyberCube delivers the world's leading analytics to quantify digital risk, helping the largest global carriers, reinsurers and brokers understand, price and manage cyber risk in financial terms.

  • AI at our foundation, cyber risk at our core. We don't just use AI, we shape it.

  • Built on AI from day one. Artificial intelligence has been part of our strategy since the beginning, blended with deep cybersecurity and insurance expertise and backed by rigorous testing.

  • Trusted by more than 100 clients, including 75% of the top 40 European and US cyber insurance carriers and 70% of the top ten reinsurance brokers.

  • Backed for global growth. In 2025 Spectrum Equity joined some of CyberCube’s financial partners as a new cornerstone investor, accelerating our global growth and fueling innovation across our end-to-end cyber risk analytics for the insurance industry.

  • A truly global team across San Francisco, New York, London, and Tallinn.

  • A culture of collaboration, openness, intellectual rigor, and ownership for excellence.

  • People at the forefront. We encourage CyberCubers to challenge themselves, push boundaries, and do the best work of their careers.

The Role
We are hiring a Senior Director, Marketing to own the whole marketing function across demand generation, product marketing, and communications/events, with accountability for pipeline contribution, the market narrative, and the marketing budget. The team is seven people across the US and UK. You will set direction, connect marketing to the commercial number, and run as one go-to-market unit with our (Re)Insurance Sales and Broker Sales leaders.

 

Based in London or New York, with regular travel across the US and Europe.

 

What You Will Do

  • Own and lead the full marketing function: demand generation, product marketing, and communications/events, including the team across the US and UK and the complete marketing budget.

  • Bring the team together with a clear marketing plan and operating rhythm, and connect the function to the commercial number.

  • Own an agreed and evidenced marketing contribution to pipeline, reported consistently and trusted by sales leadership and the board. Run the function off numbers: pipeline sourced and influenced, conversion by stage, cost per opportunity and programme return.

  • Refresh positioning and messaging for a technical analytics product and hold the line on the narrative across marketing, sales and product, so the same story is told the same way.

  • Hold and defend the full marketing budget. Make real allocation trade-offs between headcount, programmes, brand and events, reallocate on evidence, and show what each dollar returned and what was stopped.

  • Lead and coach the team. Retain and stretch top performers, set clear expectations, and shape the team structure around the plan.

  • Build a measurably stronger share of voice in cyber risk analytics across insurance and reinsurance media, analysts, and industry events.

  • Run marketing across US and European markets. Judge where a global message holds and where it has to flex, and manage a team split across time zones without defaulting to one side.

  • Partner closely with Sales and Product, and run as one go-to-market unit with the (Re)Insurance Sales and Broker Sales leaders.

 

What We Look For

  • Proven marketing leadership across all three pillars: demand generation, product marketing and communications/events, with a team of comparable size and seniority. Has set the plan, allocated a budget and been held to a pipeline number.

  • Has marketed complex software, data or analytics into large enterprise buyers in a B2B SaaS or analytics business. Long cycles, multiple stakeholders, technical evaluation, six- and seven-figure ACVs. Understands how marketing creates and accelerates enterprise pipeline rather than reporting on it.

  • International experience. Has run marketing across US and European markets and managed a team split across time zones.

  • Budget ownership. Has held and defended a full marketing budget, made real allocation trade-offs between headcount, programmes, brand and events, and can evidence return.

  • Metrics-oriented. Runs the function off numbers and is comfortable being inspected on them alongside sales. Knows the funnel numbers without looking them up and coaches the team against them. Stops what is not working quickly and moves the budget to what is.

  • Product marketing judgement. Can shape positioning and messaging for a technical analytics product and hold the line on the narrative across sales, product and comms.

  • Commercially accountable. Volunteers for the number rather than negotiating away from it, and is as comfortable in a forecast review as in a creative one. Not precious about which activities get prioritised, and agile enough to change them as the company scales.

  • Executive credible. Articulate on the commercial argument, unfazed by seniority, trusted to carry the CyberCube story.

  • A high accountability people leader who raises the bar on an existing team. Sets clear expectations, gives direct feedback, and is respected for it.

  • Strong editorial judgment and taste. Will not ship undifferentiated content, and can tell the difference between a message that resonates with the market and one that only resonates internally.

  • Partners with Sales and Product by choice, not by process. Low ego, high candour. Comfortable disagreeing with the executive team and being disagreed with.

  • Based in London, with regular international travel across the US and Europe.

 

Strong Plus

  • Has marketed into insurance, reinsurance or financial services. Carriers, reinsurers, brokers, MGAs, the Lloyd's market, banks or asset managers. A major differentiator, but not a requirement.

  • Experience marketing alongside a direct enterprise sales team with named accounts, including account-based marketing into a defined target list.

  • Has built or materially raised a brand in a category that needed defining rather than one that already existed.

  • Has run a flagship industry event presence and an executive speaking programme, and can judge which events are worth the money.

  • Analyst and media relations experience, and comfort with thought leadership built on proprietary data.

  • Has scaled a marketing function through a step change in growth expectations.

  • Comfort in a fast-moving, AI-enabled commercial function. AI-assisted content production, agentic prospecting, automated reporting, no traditional SDR layer.

AI Fluency at CyberCube

AI is reshaping how work gets done across every function. We value people who are curious about AI, eager to learn, and thoughtful about applying AI tools to work more effectively. AI fluency is part of how we assess every role in our hiring process.

source_record.description:
Accurx is solving healthcare productivity for the NHS

For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. At Accurx, we’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that helps every patient get gold-standard, efficient, and joined-up care.

What started as a way for GPs to text a patient, has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices and 68% (and growing!) of NHS Trusts.

Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book that lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe, our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.

We’re not just shipping features. We’re giving clinicians their time back and ensuring every patient journey is as smooth as it should be.


How you'll empower our tech and product leadership

You be a strategic partner and a vital force multiplier for our Chief Product Officer, Tom (CPrO) and incoming Chief Technology Officer (CTO). By anticipating their needs, shaping their organisational engagement, and prioritising their diaries against company objectives, you will help turn their strategic vision into real momentum across the Product & Technology teams.

  • Owning the operating rhythm: You will proactively manage the executives' time and diaries, utilising your knowledge of Product Development Lifecycles and Engineering to effectively balance urgent requests with important strategic priorities.

  • Driving strategic communications: You will draft, shape, and constructively challenge key messaging from the executives, ensuring communications are clear, consistent, and land successfully with various audiences.

  • Preparing with a point of view: You will go beyond basic preparation by synthesising information, highlighting crucial details, and recommending decisions ahead of key meetings and board sessions.

  • Being the ear to the ground: You will stay attuned to team sentiment and blockers across Product & Technology, bringing insights to the executives early and advising on the best response.

  • Fostering an AI-native culture: You will partner with the executives and other Executive Assistants to design impactful cultural moments, such as hackathons and Town Hall meetings, ensuring momentum continues long after the events conclude.

  • Running the Product & Tech engine: You will oversee logistics for the Product & Tech Leadership forum, manage fast-changing schedules, and monitor asynchronous Slack conversations to highlight matters needing executive attention.

  • Delivering impactful projects and events: You will own and run projects on behalf of the executives from planning to delivery, while also managing the logistics for internal and external events, offsites, and team socials.


You should apply if...

  • You are an experienced Executive Assistant: You have previously supported Product, Tech, or Engineering leaders within a B2B SaaS environment.

  • Proactive forward-thinking is your natural state: You excel at thinking multiple steps ahead, actioning potential next steps before the executives have even considered them.

  • You're a critical prioritisation partner: You are a critical thinker who has the ability to challenge executives on their priorities, messaging, or plans to keep them focused on what matters.

  • You use AI as your teammate: You are confident leveraging AI tools, effective prompting, and automation to redefine how you work and find smarter ways to execute.

  • You're the master of diaries and complex logistics: You have excellent time-management skills, meticulous attention to detail, and a proven track record managing fast-changing schedules and team events under tight deadlines.

  • You have strong industry and business acumen: You understand how product and engineering organisations deliver, enabling you to help leaders balance the urgent with the important.

  • You're an empathetic, high-EQ communicator: You influence senior stakeholders without formal authority, read how change lands across an organisation, and adapt your communication style seamlessly.

What’s in it for me?

You'll be joining an established but fast-growing Tech for Good movement, where we're led by our Principles and our mission to solve healthcare productivity.

  • £60,000 - £70,000 salary + share options up to £15,000

  • Benefits to suit you: adjust your healthcare cover, your pension or life insurance, whatever stage you’re at in life

  • Flexible working: We are an office first culture and ask that you’re in our (dog-friendly) Shoreditch office 3 days a week, with core hours of 10am - 4pm

  • Time off: You’ll get 28 days of holiday (plus bank holidays) and up to 4 weeks to work from anywhere per year

  • Family matters: We offer enhanced parental leave, fertility support and parental loss support

  • We have our very own Chef! Free healthy breakfasts, snacks and lunches will be provided, with the occasional sweet treat!

Want to know more about the company or the hiring process? Check out our Careers page and Candidate hub.

source_record.description:
At NewOrbit Space, our mission is to engineer the lowest orbiting satellites on Earth to rapidly advance global connectivity and insight.

We are currently building satellites that can operate at an altitude of just 200 km - one-third that of conventional satellites.

Role Overview

Responsible for the mechanical design of satellite structures, mechanisms, and related hardware from concept through qualification and on-orbit operation.

Working within a small, multidisciplinary team, you will translate requirements into manufacturable designs and validate them through prototyping and environmental testing.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop mechanical systems and components for satellites, including primary structure, thermal-control hardware, secondary structures, and mechanisms.

  • Generate 3D CAD models, fully dimensioned drawings, and interface control documents using GD&T, managing assembly configuration and PLM data.

  • Take hardware from conceptual design through qualification to on-orbit operations, leading design reviews, and planning verification tests.

  • Optimise designs for manufacturability, cost, mass, and reliability, working directly with manufacturers and suppliers.

  • Support prototype builds, assembly, integration, and environmental test campaigns, iterating designs based on results.

  • Collaborate with electrical, software, systems, and thermal engineers to integrate mechanical components into the satellite platform.

 

Required Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, aerospace, or related engineering discipline.

  • 5+ years’ experience in satellite mechanical design, including primary structure, pipe routing, electromechanics, and MGSE for aerospace applications (satellites, payloads, launch vehicles).

  • Proficiency in CAD software such as SolidWorks.

  • Practical application of GD&T and experience producing manufacturing-ready drawings.

  • Solid grounding in mechanical design principles, materials, structural mechanics, FEA ,and thermal management.

  • Demonstrated ability to design, build, and test hardware, including troubleshooting and iteration.

 

Why NewOrbit Space?

  • Pioneering Space Technology – You'll contribute to launching groundbreaking technology into space. Your work on our revolutionary ion propulsion system and VLEO satellite platform will redefine satellite operations and disrupt traditional LEO operations.

  • Unmatched Ownership and Impact – You'll experience a level of ownership that's rare in the space industry. You will participate in the full lifecycle of satellite technology.

  • Equity and Competitive Salary – You'll receive not just a competitive salary but also company ownership stakes. Your dedication and hard work are rewarded with a share in the technology you help build, ensuring you're a part of our collective success.

  • Comprehensive Benefits Package – Including private health insurance with dental and optical coverage, annual healthcare check-ups etc.

  • Hybrid Work - A hybrid setup with one dedicated remote day per week.

  • Visa Sponsorship & Relocation Support - We provide a relocation package and sponsor your visa if you’re joining us from abroad.

source_record.description:
Get to know us

Ideals is a global B2B SaaS product company recognized as the most highly rated and customer-centric brand in the secure business collaboration market. Trusted by over 2,000,000 users from 300,000 companies globally, we help people run high-stakes processes and make important decisions with less stress, higher quality, and shorter hours.

Ideals Virtual Data Room (VDR): Secure document sharing and collaboration for due diligence, fundraising, corporate reporting, licensing, clinical trials, and other complex transactions.

The role

Ideals has been in the Virtual Data Room space since 2008 and has built a trusted reputation with clients across multiple industries in Europe, including Deloitte, and EY.

To support the next stage of Ideals VDR growth in France, we are looking for an Enterprise Account Executive based in Paris. Joining our French Key Accounts team, you will own the full new business sales cycle and sell directly to a wide variety of enterprise corporations across diverse industries (such as energy, pharma, biotech, telecommunications, etc.).

As a quota-carrying strategic seller, your primary goal will be to grow sales and revenue through the acquisition of new strategic enterprise accounts and the expansion of existing ones. You will act as an impactful industry expert, generating demand, navigating complex 6 to 9-month sales cycles, and displacing incumbents by utilizing deep discovery and consultative selling frameworks.

Compensation package: 50% base salary; 50% performance-based variable.

Why Ideals?

  • Industry-leading sales culture: Ideals ranks among the Top-10% of companies on RepVue, as rated by sales professionals. You’ll be empowered with dedicated Sales Enablement, RevOps, Marketing support, and a structured onboarding ramp.

  • Stable growth: You’ll join a profitable, bootstrapped SaaS company that is positioned to deliver 5x revenue expansion and reach unicorn status in the next 5 years. The deals you close will shape Ideals' footprint in France and feed into our global scaling ambition.

  • Sales motion built on regional nuance: You’ll be part of a European-headquartered org, with over 18 years of selling in the VDR business. You'll drive GTM in the region we understand deeply, backed by a product that already powers 10%+ of global M&A activity.

What you will do

  • Proactively build and manage a pipeline focused on the acquisition of new strategic enterprise accounts (new logos)

  • Conduct solution-based sales engagements, including client meetings, executive presentations, and product demonstrations (face-to-face and virtual)

  • Maintain "White Space" analysis and execute strategic initiatives to upsell and cross-sell within the existing customer base

  • Develop and deliver comprehensive business cases that quantify the cost of inaction and address customer priorities, pain points, and ROI

  • Structure, negotiate, and close complex deals, guiding corporate clients step-by-step through enterprise procurement, security compliance, and legal processes

  • Orchestrate multi-threading strategies to navigate enterprise politics, establishing strong relationships with C-Suite executives and key stakeholders across various verticals

  • Keep an accurate track record of personal sales activities in the CRM, including methodical mid- and long-term forecasting

  • Provide relevant customer feedback to the product development team and collaborate with Customer Success, Marketing, and Inbound Sales to maximize revenue and customer satisfaction

What you bring

  • 4–7 years of demonstrable quota-carrying success in B2B sales

  • Proven track record of managing lengthy or complex enterprise sales cycles

  • Significant experience selling directly to C-level executives (CxOs) and multi-threading within large enterprise organizations

  • Clear understanding of, and practical experience with, consultative sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDIC/MEDPIC, SPIN, Challenger)

  • Exceptional business communication skills, enabling you to execute executive storytelling, challenge the status quo, and handle complex contracting negotiations

  • High learning agility, analytical thinking, and commercial curiosity to quickly grasp the nuances of various corporate industries

  • High AI fluency and advanced CRM tracking skills

  • Native-level proficiency in French with professional English level (C1+)

  • Based in Paris or within a realistic commuting distance for regular in-person client meetings

Nice to have

  • Background in SaaS, financial technology, or information security sectors

  • Familiarity with enterprise M&A use cases and corporate compliance workflows

What we offer

We highly value our people, so we will empower you with all the resources and support to help you reach your full potential.

For your best work

  • Remote-first flexibility to shape your ideal workday

  • Home workplace budget

  • Co-working expense coverage

  • Individual IT budget for extra equipment

  • Top-tier tech and AI-powered tools

For your growth

  • Access to Ideals Academy with numerous courses

  • Investment in external learning and development activities

  • Guidance in Personal Development Plan creation

  • Professional literature and subscriptions coverage

  • Support of your passion as a speaker or writer

  • Internal talent mobility opportunities

For your well-being

  • Tailored Wellness Package to support your physical and mental health

  • Urban Sports membership

  • Funding for sports competitions

  • 25 business days of paid time off per year

  • Paid health-related time off

Extra perks

  • Budget for team gatherings

  • Generous internal referral program

Our culture

Commitment, Excellence, Collaboration, Trust and Care are core values to the Ideals team. For us, these are the principles that every Idealer lives and breathes. We are on the lookout for like-minded individuals who share our values. By doing so, we create a team where talents feel at ease and work to the best of their abilities.

Discover more.

Ideals is an equal opportunity employer

Ideals is made up of people from a wide variety of backgrounds and lifestyles. We embrace diversity and invite applications from people from all walks of life. We don’t discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, national origin, or citizenship.

Nos agents IA automatisent les workflows à forte friction, cotation, comparaison de contrats, analyse des garanties, vérification de conformité, génération de documents et produisent des résultats structurés et actionnables en quelques minutes plutôt qu'en heures.

Nous accompagnons les cabinets de courtage en France et en Belgique, avec une conviction claire : le courtage en assurance est opérationnellement dysfonctionnel depuis des décennies, et l'IA est enfin le bon outil pour y remédier. L'IA n'est plus optionnelle pour les courtiers : elle devient le standard. La question n'est plus si, mais à quel point elle est bien mise en œuvre.

Panora a été fondée par Diane et Fabian. Diane a passé plusieurs années en capital-risque avec une solide expérience opérationnelle et connaît de l'intérieur les défis du scaling de business complexes. Fabian est un fondateur multi-récidiviste et ingénieur IA orienté produit, pionnier dans la construction de systèmes IA qui fonctionnent vraiment en production. Ensemble, ils ont décidé de créer Panora pour transformer les opérations d'assurance en avantage concurrentiel en temps réel pour les courtiers.

Panora est soutenue par Hexa (anciennement eFounders), le studio de startups pionnier en Europe, qui a lancé plus de 35 entreprises dont des licornes comme Front, Aircall et Spendesk.

Pourquoi ce rôle existe

Nous avons construit une IA qui lit des contrats, compare des garanties et génère des analyses de couverture à grande échelle. La technologie fonctionne. Nous avons maintenant besoin de quelqu'un qui la rende brillante : quelqu'un d'assez méticuleux pour détecter chaque lacune, d'assez expérimenté pour savoir ce qui compte vraiment dans une police, et d'assez curieux pour vouloir façonner l'IA de l'intérieur.

Vous serez le cerveau assurance de Panora, la personne qui examine ce que notre IA produit, vérifie chaque synthèse, et réinjecte son expertise dans le système pour qu'il s'améliore en continu. C'est une opportunité unique de vivre la transformation par l'IA de l'intérieur et de participer activement à la construction du futur du courtage.

Vos responsabilités

  • Vérification des outputs IA, contrat par contrat. Vous examinez les synthèses, analyses de couverture et recommandations générées par notre IA. Vous vérifiez leur exactitude, corrigez les erreurs et garantissez que chaque output répond au niveau d'exigence qu'un courtier engagerait sa réputation à défendre. Votre œil méticuleux est la dernière ligne de défense avant que les outputs n'atteignent les clients.

  • La boucle de feedback qui rend notre IA plus intelligente. Vous identifiez les schémas dans ce que l'IA réussit et rate. Vous travaillez avec les équipes produit et engineering pour réinjecter votre expertise assurance dans le système — améliorer les prompts, affiner le raisonnement, encoder les nuances que seules des années d'expérience permettent de saisir.

  • Accompagnement client et confiance. Vous soutenez l'onboarding des clients et leur usage au quotidien, en aidant les courtiers à comprendre et faire confiance aux outputs de l'IA.   • Expertise assurance en IARD et Santé. Vous apportez une expertise approfondie en assurance dommages (IARD) et en assurance santé : les deux piliers de notre produit actuel. Vous en maîtrisez les spécificités et garantissez que notre IA traite les deux avec précision.

  • Expérience en tant que courtier, souscripteur, ou dans un rôle d'analyse technique des couvertures

  • Expertise approfondie en IARD et/ou santé : vous connaissez ces produits sur le bout des doigts

  • Méticuleux de nature : vous êtes la personne qui repère l'exclusion enfouie page 47

  • Vous lisez un contrat et identifiez immédiatement ce qui compte, ce qui manque, et ce qui pourrait nuire à un client

  • Vous écrivez clairement et savez expliquer des concepts complexes d'assurance à des non-experts

  • Vous êtes sincèrement curieux de ce que l'IA change pour notre secteur, enthousiaste à l'idée de le vivre de l'intérieur et d'y contribuer

  • Vous êtes à l'aise dans l'ambiguïté et attachez plus d'importance au métier de l'assurance qu'au confort de la routine

  • Français courant ; l'anglais est un plus

Ce rôle est fait pour vous si

  • Vous avez passé des années à maîtriser l'assurance et souhaitez encoder cette expertise dans un produit qui transforme l'industrie

  • L'idée de vivre la transformation par l'IA de l'intérieur vous enthousiasme, pas seulement utiliser des outils, mais les construire

  • Vous êtes méticuleux, rigoureux, et mettez un point d'honneur à bien faire les choses

  • Vous aimez accompagner les clients et les aider à réussir

  • Vous voulez rejoindre suffisamment tôt pour façonner ce que doit être le courtage assisté par IA

Ce rôle n'est pas fait pour vous si

  • Vous cherchez un poste de courtage traditionnel avec un portefeuille clients et des objectifs commerciaux

  • Vous préférez la routine à la construction from scratch

  • Les détails vous ennuient

Ce qui rend ce rôle unique

  • Vous rejoignez à un stade où le produit est suffisamment jeune pour que votre expertise façonne directement son intelligence

  • Vous vérifierez et améliorerez les outputs IA en IARD, Santé, et au-delà au fil de notre expansion

  • Vous faites partie de la boucle de feedback qui rend notre IA continuellement plus intelligente

  • Vous vivez la transformation par l'IA de l'intérieur — un point de vue rare dans le secteur

  • Vous êtes un membre fondateur d'une équipe qui construit l'OS IA pour les courtiers européens. Cela signifie une vraie ownership, un vrai impact, et une trajectoire qui évolue avec Panora.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

  • Responsabilité de niveau fondateur et impact direct sur le produit

  • Votre expertise assurance devient l'intelligence du produit

  • Une place au premier rang de la transformation IA en assurance, vue de l'intérieur

  • Courbe d'apprentissage intense à l'intersection de l'assurance et de l'IA

  • Package de rémunération compétitif, incluant des equity

  • Travaillez depuis les bureaux d'Hexa aux côtés de fondateurs, d'opérateurs et d'autres startups en early stage

Processus de recrutement

  1. Call intro avec l'équipe Talent d'Hexa (30 minutes)

  2. Call fit avec Diane pour comprendre votre parcours et votre expertise (30 minutes)

  3. Un scénario assurance réel : examiner une synthèse générée par l'IA, identifier les lacunes et expliquer comment vous amélioreriez l'output (à faire chez vous + restitution de 45 minutes avec Diane et Fabian)

  4. Une rencontre avec Fabien (CTO)

  5. Un entretien avec Matthieu, Partner chez Hexa

Panora s'engage à créer un environnement diversifié. Tous les candidats qualifiés seront considérés sans distinction de genre, origine, identité, parcours ou orientation sexuelle.

Nous savons qu'il reste beaucoup à faire en matière de diversité dans notre secteur, c'est pourquoi nous encourageons toutes les candidatures — en particulier celles issues de milieux sous-représentés.

source_record.description:
Today, successful software companies have two ways to support and finance their growth: the VC path, and the self-financed profitable path. For software companies that can’t or do not want to bootstrap, but haven’t managed to stay permanently on hyper-growth, the VC path is a dead-end.

At Hexa Scale, we’re on a mission to solve this: offer a new alternative to fund and scale software companies towards exponential growth.

We believe that there are great software companies, still early stages in the 1-10m€ ARR range, that sit on amazing markets with a great product, but that require a few changes to unlock their potential.

We believe that by providing them with capital and strong operational leverage, we can put them on the right trajectory, towards category-leading exponential growth. Our full manifesto.

Your role is to help us find, select and invest in those companies.

Mission

Within Hexa Scale’s team (Thibault, Augustin & Samuel), you’ll participate in the deal-flow cycle to make 2/3 successful deals a year.

Outcomes

Deal-flow: guarantee volume and reactivity

  • Perform the first analysis of Inbound leads, and therefore guarantee a <48h contact to the entrepreneurs.

  • Identify new companies that fit our investment scope each week for reach out and ensure a strong volume generation at the top of our investment funnel, target: 30 identified companies

  • Help us to enhance our outbound tooling set-up (database, automations, scraping)

Research: help perform cutting edge market deep-dives

  • Perform research on sectors that we decide to deep-dive: mapping of actors, mapping of products and features, understanding of competitive landscape, understanding of funding status and exit potential, understanding of value-creation for customers and GTM structures.

  • Participate in qualitative research with market experts: Identify, reach-out and organise calls with market experts that we may not have directly in our network, at scale. Example: generate 10+ interviews with key buyer persona on a researched market.

Company analysis: help elaborate clear pictures of our targets

  • Understand and analyse the business model, product, team, growth engine, and overall business plan of our targets. Participate in our version of the BP to understand key assumptions and risks, and generate a clear picture of the investment opportunity.

  • Support Hexa Scale’s team in both intro and due diligence calls

Competences & Profile

  • Currently enrolled in a Master’s degree of top Business/Engineering school

  • At least 1 experience in GTM, Tech M&A or an investment role (PE, VC)

  • Entrepreneurship oriented: Great doer, fast self-learner, self-starter mindset

  • Very curious about tech/software and permanently digging topics to get to the heart of things

  • Strong analytical skills and ability to articulate opinions with both numbers and concepts

  • Highly coachable: enjoying and asking for feedback and training

Process

  • 1st Intro call with our Talent Team (20min)

  • Meeting with Samuel to get to know each other and discuss about your experiences and interests (20min)

  • Business Case & Feedback session with the team (1h)

  • Reference checks & ☕ with Samuel

Environnement professionnel

L’Agence de services et de paiement est un organisme de paiement public dédié à la mise en place de politiques publiques.

Vous rejoindrez la Direction du Développement Rural et de la Pêche (DDRP) qui assure la mise en œuvre opérationnelle de politiques publiques confiées à l’ASP dans les domaines de l’agriculture, du développement rural et de la pêche.

Au sein de la sous direction « métier », vous intégrerez le service des aides au développement rural et à la pêche (SADRP) chargé de la mise en œuvre des mesures du développement rural (hors SIGC) cofinancées par le Fonds européen agricole pour le développement rural (FEADER), 2nd pilier de la PAC, et d’aides nationales dans le domaine agricole et de la pêche.

Pour exercer sa mission, la DDRP s'appuie sur un réseau de directions (inter)régionales (D(I)R) qui couvre l'ensemble du territoire.

Vous exercerez votre mission dans le service des aides au développement rural et à la pêche (SADRP) au sein du secteur des aides nationales et Feader (SANF).

Objectifs

  • Le poste proposé repose sur 3 objectifs :

    •Assurer le rôle de référent de dispositifs d’aide nationale mis en place par les ministères donneurs d’ordre

    •Contribuer à la maîtrise d’ouvrage des systèmes de gestion informatiques (outil SAFRAN et lien avec les outils de la chaine de l’ordonnateur)

    •Apporter une expertise sur une ou des thématiques transversales au service

Missions

Ingénierie administrative de dispositifs d’aide nationale dans le cadre fixé par le donneur d’ordre:

  • Apporter un appui au donneur d’ordre et aux DR- ASP en matière d’expertise réglementaire et de processus de gestion

  • Accompagnement et suivi de la mise en œuvre, reporting et tableaux de bord, notamment sur les besoins de financement

  • Contribution à l’assistance utilisateurs, traitement des tickets incidents (TI)

    Contribution à la maîtrise d’ouvrage des systèmes de gestion

  • Contribuer à la maîtrise d’ouvrage des outils permettant l’instruction et le paiement des aides: expressions de besoins, recettes fonctionnelles

  • Apporter un appui à l’assistance utilisateurs (formations, consignes, aides en ligne, …)

  • Contribuer au bon fonctionnement des outils, alerter sur les éventuelles difficultés et proposer des évolutions

    Référent thématique sur certains sujets

  • Pour certains sujets d’intérêt transversal au service, assurer une veille sur la thématique et rédiger des notes, procédures

  • Organiser et animer des réunions, participer à des groupes de travail, rédiger les comptes-rendus

Champ relationnel

  • Relation régulière avec

    •Interlocuteurs internes : les directions régionales de l’ASP, les autres services de la direction, d’autres directions de l’ASP

    •Interlocuteurs externes : les ministères donneurs d’ordre (surtout ministère en charge de l’agriculture et ministère en charge de la transition écologique, le cas échéant les services déconcentrés de ces ministères (DRAAF, DDT), …

Savoirs

  • Connaissance de l’environnement institutionnel  français

  • Connaissance de la réglementation liée aux aides agricoles, notamment encadrement des aides d’Etat

  • Connaissance des procédures de paiement de l’établissement

Savoir-faire

  • Capacité à travailler en équipe et en réseau

  • Qualités rédactionnelles

  • Capacité d’analyse et de synthèse

  • Capacité à rendre compte, à établir des indicateurs et  bilans

  • Rigueur

  • Capacité à travailler en mode projet

Savoir-être

  • Qualités relationnelles

  • Sens de l’initiative

  • Polyvalence, disponibilité

  • Capacité d’adaptation

  • Autonomie

  • Réactivité

Conditions particulières d’exercice

Assurer la suppléance ou l’intérim des agents du secteur en leur absence en cas d’urgence.

Télétravail possible selon les conditions mises en place par l’agence.

Ingénieur suivi de production - support niveau 2 H/F Agence de services et de paiement Montreuil SIEGE - DSDA Manager fulltime permanent 54 minutes SIEGE - DSDA Manager fulltime permanent Montreuil 54m _______________________ Domaine : Numérique Nature du poste : Pérenne - PASP001483 Statut : Fonctionnaire - ouvert aux contractuels Corps : AAE/IAE Cotation RIFSEEP : G3.B Cotation Parcours professionnel : 1 Pour les contractuels Fondement juridique du contrat : L 332-1 Niveau d’études : à partir de Bac +3 Durée du contrat : jusqu’à 3 ans Date de vacance de l’emploi : 15/12/2026 Date limite de candidature : 25/10/2026 ________________________ Environnement professionnel L'Agence de Services et de Paiement (ASP) est un établissement public administratif placé sous la double tutelle du Ministère en charge de l'Agriculture et du Ministère en charge de l’Emploi. L'ASP est le premier organisme payeur européen des aides de la politique agricole commune (PAC). Au sein de la Direction des soutiens directs agricoles, le poste proposé est rattaché au service qui assure l’assistance à maîtrise d’ouvrage du système intégré de gestion et de contrôle (SIGC), sur lequel s'appuie la gestion des aides directes de la PAC (300.000 agriculteurs et 8,5 milliards d'Euros gérés). La direction des opérations est organisé en 4 secteurs. Le poste proposé est situé au sein du secteur «suivi de production, automates et sécurité», en charge de l’assistance aux utilisateurs, du pilotage des activités liées à l’hébergement et l’architecture fonctionnelle comme technique, la définition et le suivi des audits liés à la sécurité informatique. Objectifs Ce poste a pour objectif d’assurer que le système d’information ISIS/Telepac de production assure le service attendu par ses utilisateurs. Le/la titulaire, avec son binôme, assure le support de niveau 2 aux utilisateurs, ainsi que le suivi du bon fonctionnement du système grâce à des outils de suivi techniques et fonctionnels, ainsi que le pilotage des multiples actions nécessaires au déroulement des campagnes de paiement. _______________________

Domaine : Numérique
Nature du poste : Pérenne - PASP001483
Statut : Fonctionnaire - ouvert aux contractuels
Corps : AAE/IAE
Cotation RIFSEEP : G3.B
Cotation Parcours professionnel : 1


Pour les contractuels
Fondement juridique du contrat : L 332-1
Niveau d’études : à partir de Bac +3
Durée du contrat : jusqu’à 3 ans

Date de vacance de l’emploi : 15/12/2026
Date limite de candidature : 25/10/2026

________________________

Environnement professionnel

L'Agence de Services et de Paiement (ASP) est un établissement public administratif placé sous la double tutelle du Ministère en charge de l'Agriculture et du Ministère en charge de l’Emploi. L'ASP est le premier organisme payeur européen des aides de la politique agricole commune (PAC).

Au sein de la Direction des soutiens directs agricoles, le poste proposé est rattaché au service qui assure l’assistance à maîtrise d’ouvrage du système intégré de gestion et de contrôle (SIGC), sur lequel s'appuie la gestion des aides directes de la PAC (300.000 agriculteurs et 8,5 milliards d'Euros gérés).

La direction des opérations est organisé en 4 secteurs. Le poste proposé est situé au sein du secteur «suivi de production, automates et sécurité», en charge de l’assistance aux utilisateurs, du pilotage des activités liées à l’hébergement et l’architecture fonctionnelle comme technique, la définition et le suivi des audits liés à la sécurité informatique.

Objectifs

Ce poste a pour objectif d’assurer que le  système d’information ISIS/Telepac de production assure le service attendu par ses utilisateurs.

Le/la titulaire, avec son binôme, assure le support de niveau 2 aux utilisateurs, ainsi que le suivi du bon fonctionnement du système grâce à des outils de suivi techniques et fonctionnels, ainsi que le pilotage des multiples actions nécessaires au déroulement des campagnes de paiement. Il/elle assure le lien avec les parties prenantes extérieures intervenant dans cette mission.

Missions

Dans le cadre de sa mission de support de niveau 2, le/la titulaire prend en charge :

  • La réception des signalements d’incidents, en provenance du support de niveau 1 interne et du support externalisé

  • La reproduction et la qualification des incidents pour transmission aux équipes fonctionnelles ou au prestataire de maintenance

  • Le suivi du développement des correctifs et l’information des utilisateurs en retour

  • Le suivi opérationnel du prestataire de support externalisé, en particulier durant le déroulement de la campagne de télédéclaration

Le/la titulaire assure également le suivi du bon fonctionnement du système

  • En s’appuyant sur des outils de suivi techniques et fonctionnels, il/elle anticipe l’apparition des problèmes

  • Il/elle assure le pilotage de certains traitements nécessaires au bon fonctionnement du système

Dans le cadre de son secteur :

Le/la titulaire est amené(e) à contribuer ponctuellement a l’ensemble des tâches de son secteur, et à être force de proposition pour améliorer le fonctionnement du système ISIS/Telepac et des équipes qui en sont responsables.

Champ relationnel

Le/la titulaire du poste est en relation privilégiée avec les interlocuteurs suivants :

  • Services métiers assurant le support de niveau 1

  • Prestataire assurant le support téléphonique

  • Prestataires assurant la maitrise d’œuvre du système d’information de la direction

  • Autres secteurs de la direction des opérations : expert fonctionnels, ingénieurs de recette, architectes

  • Partenaires extérieurs et fournisseurs de données

Savoirs

  • Pratique du support utilisateur

  • Connaissance des pratiques de gestion de projet informatique

  • Connaissance des métiers de l’expertise fonctionnelle ou de la recette

Savoir-faire

  • Esprit de synthèse et capacité rédactionnelle

  • Capacité à comprendre le métier des utilisateurs

  • Capacité à lire et comprendre les spécifications fonctionnelles

  • Rigueur dans le suivi des incidents

Savoir-être

  • Réactivité et adaptabilité

  • Aptitude à communiquer et à travailler en équipe

Conditions particulières d’exercice

Aucune

  • Damien SEUX

    Directeur des opérations

Depuis 2006, nous aidons les entreprises à optimiser leur marketing et leurs opérations en combinant IA avec expertise business et technologique dans 4 domaines : Marketing & commercial effectiveness, Customer analytics, Operational excellence, ESG & sustainability. Ekimetrics est un leader mondial de l'efficacité marketing et commerciale et des solutions d'IA à l'échelle. Depuis 2006, nous aidons les entreprises à optimiser leur marketing et leurs opérations en combinant IA avec expertise business et technologique dans 4 domaines : Marketing & commercial effectiveness, Customer analytics, Operational excellence, ESG & sustainability.  
 
Avec une équipe 100% internalisée et des bureaux à Paris, Londres, New York, Hong Kong et Shanghai, nous concevons des solutions sur mesure qui transforment les données en impact positif concret, grâce à une combinaison unique de technologie et de services.
 
Notre force est de déployer une IA à impact, à grande échelle. Notre mission : mobiliser cette puissance pour répondre aux défis les plus urgents de notre temps. Nous nous engageons pour une IA responsable et frugale, pour garantir un impact constant à grande échelle, et pour rester fidèles à nos valeurs et à notre ADN.  

Pourquoi recrutons-nous ?

 

Dans le cadre d’un accroissement d’activité, nous souhaitons renforcer notre équipe finance groupe en accueillant un.e stagiaire en finance/contrôle de gestion. L'équipe se compose aujourd'hui de Florie-Anne Thuet (Directrice Financière) et Arnaud Vermeulen (Contrôleur financier groupe).

 

Plus précisément vous aurez pour mission :

 

-          Élaboration des indicateurs de gestion et tableaux de bord (P&L, Bilan, Cash-flow) pour le groupe

-          Suivi de la trésorerie groupe & entité Holding

-          Mise en place dans l’ERP (Microsoft Dynamics 365) de dashboard de cashflow

-          Préparation des analyses ad-hoc nécessaires dans le cadre des projets en-cours

-          Participation active aux travaux de consolidation budgétaire

-          Participation aux clôtures mensuelles, notamment en aidant à l’élaboration du Boardpack groupe consolidé et au rapprochement des intercos

 

 

Le profil et les compétences recherchées:

 

Vous suivez une formation supérieure « Grande École » ou équivalent avec une spécialisation en gestion et/ou finance. Vous souhaitez acquérir une vision transverse des métiers de l’entreprise

 

Compétences spécifiques :

· Formation comptabilité et contrôle de gestion

· Forte appétence pour Excel

· Anglais opérationnel

 

 

Qualités personnelles :

· Rigueur dans les rendus

· Vous êtes curieux

· Force de proposition

· Motivation  / Enthousiasme

Notre processus recrutement

  • Un test technique sur Excel
  • Un entretien RH avec un(e) Talent Acquisition
  • Un entretien final avec Serge ATALLAH Finance Manager Groupe
Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
 
Chez Ekimetrics, vos idées comptent vraiment et vous appartiennent — à vous de leur donner vie. Nous cultivons un esprit entrepreneurial qui vous encourage à repousser les limites pour créer un impact significatif. 
 
Mais il ne s’agit pas seulement de réussites individuelles : nous avançons ensemble, en nous enrichissant mutuellement. Ensemble, nous apprenons et progressons en continu, que ce soit à travers des parcours de carrière personnalisés, des projets stimulants, du mentorat, ou simplement grâce à la diversité des perspectives que chacun.e apporte.
 
Et surtout, nous croyons au plaisir dans le travail. Ekimetrics est un environnement stimulant et bienveillant, où chacun.e peut s’épanouir en étant pleinement soi-même.
 
En 2023, Ekimetrics a obtenu le statut d’entreprise à mission qui témoigne de notre ambition forte en matière de RSE. Notre raison d’être : Faire de la data science et de l’intelligence artificielle l’accélérateur de la transformation durable des organisations.
 
Nous sommes également certifiés Great Place to Work© en France, au Royaume-Uni et aux Etats-Unis, et notre bureau de Hong Kong a reçu le prix Best Companies to Work for in Asia 2023©.
 
Ekimetrics fait partie du classement French Tech 120 !Nous avons été sélectionnés par La French Tech pour rejoindre le prestigieux groupe des 120 scale-ups françaises les plus performantes, avec un fort potentiel pour devenir des leaders internationaux.  
 
Vous aurez accès :
 
·       Au catalogue de formation Eki.Academy qui contient des programmes qui vous feront monter en compétences sur nos solutions et nos métiers, des parcours apprenants sur notre plateforme digitale ainsi que des programmes dédiés à nos enjeux prioritaires, dont la sensibilisation aux sujets environnementaux avec la Climate School.
·       A une vie sportive, artistique, musicale, ludique, caritative et engagée : de notre salle de sport privatisée à nos expositions d’art, en passant par des jeux vidéo et des concerts, ou encore les défis RSE sur la plateforme Vendredi. Toutes ces initiatives sont portées par nos Eki.People ;
·       De nombreux évènements et séminaires pour rester proche de votre communauté ;
·       Des locaux chaleureux dans un quartier dynamique au cœur de Paris (Grands boulevards)
·       Une politique de télétravail flexible, avec 3 jours de présence obligatoire par tranche de 15 jours.
 
En tant qu’employeur, Ekimetrics offre à tous les mêmes opportunités d’accès à l’emploi sans distinction de genre, ethnicité, religion, orientation sexuelle, statut social, handicap et d’âge. Ekimetrics veille à développer un environnement de travail inclusif qui reflète la diversité dans ses équipes.

The Director of International Relations and Diplomacy (IRD) Programs, based at the Paris Campus, will provide academic leadership for Schiller International University’s undergraduate, graduate and online International Relations and Diplomacy programs across all campuses. The Director will be responsible for ensuring program currency and curriculum quality, faculty hiring and performance, and achieving student outcomes within the International Relations and Diplomacy discipline. In addition, the Director will provide Academic Leadership at the Paris Campus for all academic programs.
  
 The role encompasses the oversight of program design, curriculum development, course content, syllabi, course delivery, assessment and continuous improvement processes, ensuring compliance with U.S. accreditation standards, local regulatory requirements, and dual-degree and articulation agreements with various partners. The Director will work closely with academic leaders across campuses to recruit, evaluate, and support faculty teaching International Relations and Diplomacy courses, ensuring consistency in academic standards and learning outcomes throughout the institution. The director will also work with academic team, student experience and data team to monitor key performance indicators and help design interventions to ensure achieving student outcomes set by the university.
  
 In collaboration with Associate Deans, Directors of other academic areas, and the Paris Campus Director, the Director of International Relations and Diplomacy Programs will provide academic leadership for the Paris Campus and oversee faculty hiring and management, course allocations and academic operation. 
 
The successful candidate will work closely with faculty, staff, and other university stakeholders to foster student engagement, academic success, preparation for employment and career success, and deliver a transformative, student-centered educational experience aligned with Schiller’s experiential and challenge-based learning model.


Tasks and Responsabilities

  • Lead International Relations and Diplomacy programs design, review, and continuous improvement in collaboration with Academic team and other university offices. 
  • Participate in the review and assessment of program and course learning outcomes for International Relations and Diplomacy and other academic areas.

  • Conduct course observations as needed, both online and onsite. 
  • Collaborate with the Educational Technology team to offer faculty development activities.
  • Support the growing Distance Learning Master’s program in International Relations and Diplomacy.

  • Monitor student outcomes data weekly and to identify students at risk. Work with faculty and student services to design interventions to support their retention and success.

  • Coordinate the effective implementation of VLE templates and uniform content within International Relations and Diplomacy offerings.
  • Manage faculty workload and faculty assignment in collaboration with the other academic leaders.

  • Academic program design and review and managing faculty and staff.

They do 08/15. We create 9:16

Wir schaffen Relevanz, um Aufmerksamkeit zu erreichen und zu skalieren.

Sichtbarkeit ist nicht automatisch Relevanz. Reichweite nicht automatisch Wirkung.

WeCreate ist eine Social-First Brand Building Agency für das Interest-Media-Zeitalter. Wir übersetzen Social Signals und Community Insights in Social Strategien, Content-Systeme und messbare Markenwirkung als strategischer Partner, Campaign Co-Pilot oder operatives Umsetzungsteam. 

Für Marken, die nicht nur stattfinden, sondern kulturell und in ihren Communities relevant sein wollen, suchen wir dich als (Senior) Social Brand Manager (all genders).

Du verbindest strategische Beratung mit sicherem Account Management und konsequenter operativer Steuerung. Als verlängerter Arm unserer Kund:innen und strategische Stimme von WeCreate sorgst du dafür, dass aus Plattform- und Community-Signalen klare Entscheidungen, relevante Aktivierungen und messbare Markenwirkung werden.


Deine Rolle

Du verantwortest eigenständig Kund:innen Etats im Daily Business und führst sie sicher durch ihr Full-Social-System. Dabei steuerst du sowohl strategisch als auch operativ: von der Plattformstrategie und Aktivierungsplanung über Content, Community und Creator bis hin zu Performance, Budget und Wirtschaftlichkeit.

Du denkst Social nicht in einzelnen Gewerken, sondern als integriertes System. Du hältst Markenführung, kreative Qualität, operative Umsetzung, Paid Media und Business-Ziele zusammen mit klarer Haltung, strukturiertem Account Management und einem sicheren Gespür dafür, was auf Plattformen und in Communities funktioniert.


Dein Impact bei WeCreate

Du agierst als verlängerter Arm deiner Kund:innen und zugleich als strategische Stimme von WeCreate. Du schaffst Orientierung, wenn Plattformen, Trends und Anforderungen in Bewegung sind, und hältst Markenambition, kreative Exzellenz, operative Umsetzung und wirtschaftliche Ziele zusammen.

Du bist mehr als Schnittstelle: Du erkennst, was eine Marke jetzt braucht, übersetzt es in klare Social-Maßnahmen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit Kund:innen Systeme, die langfristig Relevanz aufbauen und Wachstum ermöglichen.


Das erwartet dich:

  • Strategisches Account Management: Du führst Kund:innen eigenständig auf Senior-Level, berätst sie zur ganzheitlichen Full-Social-Präsenz und baust langfristige Partnerschaften auf.
  • Strategische und operative Steuerung: Du übersetzt Marken- und Business-Ziele in klare Social-Strategien, Aktivierungspläne und priorisierte To-dos – auch über mehrere Projekte hinweg.
  • Channel Ownership: Du entwickelst plattformgerechte Strategien und stellst sicher, dass Inhalte zu Marke, Zielgruppe, Community und Plattformlogik passen.
  • Projekt-, Produktions- und Content-Steuerung: Du verantwortest Social-Aktivierungen, Redaktionsplanung und Produktionen von der Konzeption bis zur Freigabe. Dabei sicherst du markenkonsistenten, plattformnativen Content mit klarer Wirkungserwartung.
  • Creator- und Community-Management: Du steuerst Creator-Kooperationen ganzheitlich – von Auswahl und Verhandlung bis zu Briefing und Auswertung. Community-Learnings und kulturelle Signale übersetzt du in relevante Empfehlungen.
  • Performance-, Budget- und Paid-Media-Kompetenz: Du interpretierst Daten, leitest konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab, steuerst Budgets und Wirtschaftlichkeit und integrierst Paid Media in deine Full-Funnel-Beratung.
  • Fachliches Sparring und Systementwicklung: Du entwickelst Standards für Creator Management, Measurement und AI-gestützte Prozesse weiter, bringst dein Wissen ins Team ein und stärkst Strategie- und Creative-Kompetenz.


Das bringst du mit:

Das sind deine Kernkompetenzen

  • Du kannst komplexe Marken- und Business-Ziele in klare Social-Strategien, Prioritäten und umsetzbare Pläne übersetzen.

  • Du hast Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Führung anspruchsvoller Kund:innenetats oder Retainer – von Beratung und Planung bis Umsetzung, Performance-Review und Weiterentwicklung.

  • Du beherrschst Full Social: Plattformstrategie, Content-Systeme, Community, Creator und Paid Media gehören für dich zu einer wirksamen Markenführung zusammen.

  • Du steuerst Projekte, Budgets, Aufwände und Stakeholder vorausschauend und kannst wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge in klare Entscheidungen übersetzen.

  • Du bringst Erfahrung im Creator Management mit – inklusive Auswahl, Verhandlung, Briefing, Steuerung, Qualitätskontrolle und Auswertung.

  • Du kannst Daten und Reportings analytisch einordnen, strategische Implikationen ableiten und Handlungsempfehlungen klar vermitteln.

  • Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Marken, Content und Plattformkultur und kannst kreative Qualität konstruktiv, verbindlich und auf Augenhöhe führen.


So arbeitest du

  • Du kommunizierst klar, verbindlich und verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch sowie sicher auf Englisch.

  • Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, strukturiert und proaktiv – auch wenn sich Prioritäten, Plattformen oder Anforderungen verändern.

  • Du erkennst früh, wo Abstimmung oder Steuerung nötig ist, und handelst entsprechend – mit Kund:innen, Creator:innen und im Team.

  • Du hältst strategische Prioritäten auch bei hohem Tempo im Blick und schaffst Orientierung, wenn viele Themen gleichzeitig laufen.

  • Du hast Freude daran, Wissen zu teilen, Kolleg:innen fachlich zu sparren und Arbeitsweisen gemeinsam weiterzuentwickeln.


Das bekommst du bei uns:

Flexibilität mit Verbindung

  • Hybrides Arbeiten mit unserem Office in Hamburg als Team-Hub

  • Mindestens fünf Tage pro Monat gemeinsames Arbeiten im Office für integrierte Teamarbeit

  • Flexibles Arbeiten von zuhause und wenn du Lust auf einen Perspektivwechsel hast, nach Absprache zeitweise aus dem Ausland

  • Flexibilität für Produktionen, Workshops, Kundentermine und Offsite-Formate

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten für eine Arbeitsweise, die zu deinem Alltag passt

  • Freie Wahl deiner Hardware


Benefits, die dir wirklich etwas bringen

  • Gemeinsame Events und Workations, weil gute Zusammenarbeit nicht nur im Kalender entsteht

  • Wahlweise Zuschuss zum ÖPNV-Ticket, Probonio-Gutschein oder Urban Sports Club

  • Bagel-Frühstück im Office für einen gemeinsamen Start in den Tag


Und sonst?

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege, viel Eigenverantwortung und Vertrauen in deine Expertise

  • Eine steile Lernkurve – ohne Dauer-Überstunden als vermeintliches Karriereprogramm

  • Raum, eine wachsende Agentur und unsere Arbeitsweisen aktiv mitzugestalten

  • Flache Hierarchien sowie ein respektvoller, offener Umgang miteinander


Hinweis zur Anstellung:

Die Stelle ist zunächst auf zwei Jahre befristet – mit Option auf Verlängerung bzw. Übernahme in ein unbefristetes Arbeitsverhältnis.

Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team. Rejoignez-nous dans notre mission de transformer la façon dont le monde mange et fait ses courses. Chez Deliveroo, impact, innovation et croissance sont au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. Ce que vous ferez au quotidien En tant que Account Associate - Retail & Grocery (H/F) , vous serez responsable du succès d’un portefeuille de partenaires, afin d’assurer la meilleure expérience à nos utilisateurs, tout en construisant un partenariat solide et durable avec nos eux pour notre application.
